landmarks.bagEnd: The cozy hobbit-hole of Bilbo Baggins where Frodo inherited the One Ring and the great quest began.
landmarks.buckleburyFerry: The old Brandywine River crossing where the hobbits narrowly escaped the pursuing Black Riders.
landmarks.bree: A bustling crossroads town where Frodo first met the mysterious Strider — Aragorn, heir to the throne of Gondor — at the Prancing Pony inn.
landmarks.weathertop: The ancient ruined watchtower where the Nazgûl ambushed the Fellowship and Frodo was stabbed with a cursed Morgul-blade.
landmarks.trollshaws: Wild rocky forests where Bilbo once tricked three stone trolls — and the hobbits found their buried treasure cave.
landmarks.rivendell: The Last Homely House, elven refuge of Lord Elrond, where the Council of Elrond decided the fate of the One Ring.
landmarks.caradhras: The cruel mountain of the Misty range that buried the Fellowship in snow and ice, forcing them to seek another way.
landmarks.moria: The vast underground realm of Khazad-dûm where the Fellowship faced the Balrog — and Gandalf fell into the abyss.
landmarks.lothlorien: The golden forest realm of Lady Galadriel, where the Fellowship rested, grieved Gandalf, and received elvish gifts for the road ahead.
landmarks.anduin: The Great River carrying the Fellowship's boats southward past ancient ruins toward the falls of Rauros.
landmarks.argonath: The Pillars of the Kings — two colossal statues of Isildur and Anárion carved into cliffs, marking the ancient northern border of Gondor.
landmarks.amonHen: The Hill of Sight where the Fellowship broke apart — Frodo saw the Eye of Sauron and chose to continue alone with Sam.
landmarks.emynMuil: A maze of rocky hills where Frodo and Sam first encountered Gollum, who became their reluctant guide to Mordor.
landmarks.deadMarshes: A vast haunted swamp where the ghostly faces of long-dead warriors shimmer beneath the murky water, luring travelers to their doom.
landmarks.blackGate: The Morannon — the great iron gate and main fortified entrance to Mordor, guarded day and night by Sauron's armies.
landmarks.ithilien: A fair forested land once belonging to Gondor where Frodo and Sam were captured by Faramir's Rangers.
landmarks.minasMorgul: The Dead City — once the fair Minas Ithil, now a fortress of the Nazgûl glowing with an eerie green light.
landmarks.mordor: Sauron's dark volcanic realm surrounded by the Ash Mountains — the most perilous and desolate stretch of the entire quest.
landmarks.mountDoom: Orodruin, the Mountain of Fire — the one place in all of Middle-earth where the One Ring was forged and where it could be unmade.
